events.factual_description: Zürcher Gallery and Wet Ink Ensemble's authorized Eventbrite listing present Wet Ink's 28th Season Opener on Sunday, September 27, 2026 at 7:30 PM at Zürcher Gallery, 33 Bleecker Street in New York City. The announced program contains three world premieres: new 2026 works by Alex Mincek, Mariel Roberts Musa and Modney. The verified performers are Mincek on saxophone, Ian Antonio on percussion, Modney on violin, Roberts Musa on cello and Sam Pluta on electronics. The presenter describes the pieces as products of Wet Ink's collaborative band working methodology. General admission is pay-what-you-wish with a $20 suggested donation; student tickets are free, and tickets are also available at the door.

en.why_it_matters: The interest is in the machinery of the ensemble itself. Wet Ink opens its 28th season with three new works built inside its band-like collaborative process, using saxophone, percussion, violin, cello and electronics as one compositional laboratory rather than a conventional chamber lineup. These are actual world premieres, but the stronger reason to hear them is that the first public versions expose how this group turns performer-specific technique and electronics into music that can keep changing after the premiere.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play on September 27, actively make room for the Bleecker Street set and let it anchor the experimental side of the evening. From the DMV, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than make a dedicated trip for this concert alone.

es.why_it_matters: El interés está en la maquinaria del propio ensamble. Wet Ink abre su temporada 28 con tres obras nuevas construidas dentro de su proceso colaborativo de banda, usando saxofón, percusión, violín, cello y electrónica como un solo laboratorio compositivo en vez de una formación de cámara convencional. Son estrenos mundiales reales, pero la razón más fuerte para escucharlos es que estas primeras versiones públicas dejan ver cómo el grupo convierte técnicas específicas de sus intérpretes y electrónica en música que puede seguir transformándose después del estreno.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego el 27 de septiembre, le haría espacio activamente al set de Bleecker Street y dejaría que ancle el lado experimental de la noche. Desde el DMV, lo combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir a Nueva York en vez de hacer un viaje dedicado únicamente por este concierto.
